edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer source.
msg.sender is used as the spender in transferFrom.
msg.sender owns the allowance created by approve.
block.timestamp is compared against the per-address cooldown inside _transfer (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp is written into the cooldown mapping, making transfer eligibility time dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline in openTrading.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
transferFrom reads and reduces the stored allowance.
_transferStandard reads and updates _rOwned balances.
balanceOf reads the reflection balance and converts it to tokens.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates the token fee into _tFeeTotal.
_getCurrentSupply divides _rTotal by _tTotal to detect an anomalous rate.
_feeAddr1 is the tax fee percentage consumed by _getValues.
_feeAddr2 is the team fee percentage consumed by _getValues.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half of the ETH in sendETHToFee.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half of the ETH in sendETHToFee.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount in _transfer.
cooldown mapping is read and updated in _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to detect buys and sells.
uniswapV2Router performs the token-to-ETH swap.
uniswapV2Router is assigned and used to build the pair and add liquidity.
uniswapV2Pair is created and approved inside openTrading.
Constructor assigns the full reflection supply to the deployer in _rOwned.
Constructor sets _feeAddrWallet1.
Constructor sets _feeAddrWallet2.
Constructor sets _owner through the Ownable base.
The amount parameter flows into _transfer.
tokenAmount is forwarded to the router swap call.
The ETH amount is forwarded to the fee wallet transfers.
The bots_ array entries are written into the bots mapping.
notbot clears the corresponding bots entry.
The onoff value is assigned to cooldownEnabled.
transfer calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
_transfer conditionally swaps contract tokens for ETH.
_transfer conditionally distributes the collected ETH to fee wallets.
_transfer delegates the balance updates to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard credits the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the reflected fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard computes amounts via _getValues.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues obtains the current rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for supplies.
balanceOf converts the reflection balance through tokenFromReflection.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap.
sendETHToFee performs ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
openTrading approves the router for the full supply.
openTrading creates the Uniswap pair.
openTrading adds ETH liquidity to the pair.
openTrading grants the router an unlimited allowance over the pair token.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee on the full contract ETH balance.
setBots writes entries into the bots blacklist.
delBot clears an entry in the bots blacklist.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldownEnabled flag.
manualswap requires msg.sender to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend requires msg.sender to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
_transfer compares from/to against owner() to bypass bot, cooldown and fee restrictions.
openTrading is restricted to the contract owner via onlyOwner.
setBots is restricted to the contract owner via onlyOwner.
delBot is restricted to the contract owner via onlyOwner.
The external router swap executes before the final _tokenTransfer balance updates, so a malicious/compromised token or router can re-enter the transfer flow.
ETH is pushed to the fee wallets from inside the transfer path; the subsequent state update ordering keeps the contract open to callback-driven re-entry.
The external addLiquidityETH call runs before the trading flags (_maxTxAmount, tradingOpen) are finalized, allowing a callback to observe a half-initialized state.
